QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: Other Investment Products_34

question.text: Corporate bonds invested by NPS pension funds must have a minimum credit rating of:

explanation.text: The Logic: NPS investment guidelines require corporate bonds held in the C category to carry a minimum credit rating of AA, which sets a floor on credit quality for subscriber funds. The Trap: AAA is the highest rating but is not the minimum requirement. Ratings of A or A+ are below the AA floor and are not eligible for NPS pension fund investment in the C category. Note: Removed the mutual fund comparison and the distributor pro-tip paragraph, since neither is supported by the Series XVII pages cited in the audit. The item now stays focused on the NPS C-category eligibility rule.
